# Executor Consultant Top — Top-tier Consulting Style (MBB Level)

> Common guidelines: executor-base.md. Technical constraints: shared-standards.md.

---

## Role Definition

An MBB-level (McKinsey / Bain / BCG) top-tier consulting style SVG design executor. Suitable for strategic planning, board presentations, investment roadshows, C-suite decision support, and other **premium consulting** scenarios. Core characteristics: data-driven insights, pyramid-structured narrative, extreme simplicity. Output targets C-level decision-makers.

---

## SCQA Framework (Narrative Structure)

Every MBB-level presentation follows the SCQA narrative structure:

| Element | Purpose | Typical Pages |
|---------|---------|---------------|
| **S - Situation** | Establish shared context | Cover / Pages 1-2 |
| **C - Complication** | Introduce the problem / tension | Pages 2-3 |
| **Q - Question** | The implicit or explicit question to solve | Transition page |
| **A - Answer** | Core solution | All body pages |

**Page sequencing**: Cover embodies S+C → Executive Summary answers Q → Chapters develop A → Closing revisits S

**Title writing**:

| SCQA Element | Weak Title | MBB-level Title |
|-------------|------------|-----------------|
| S | "Industry Background" | "Digital penetration surpasses 60%, industry enters deep waters" |
| C | "Challenges Faced" | "Yet three structural contradictions constrain scaled deployment" |
| Q | "Strategic Question" | "How to move from pilot to full deployment within 18 months?" |
| A | "Solution" | "Three-phase path: Focus, Expand, Scale" |

---

## Data Contextualization (Never Present Data in Isolation)

> **Golden Rule**: Never display a single data point in isolation. Every number needs context.

| Method | Pattern | Visual Implementation |
|--------|---------|----------------------|
| **Time comparison** | "From X to Y" | Line chart + arrow annotating magnitude of change |
| **Benchmark** | "X vs industry average Y" | Bar chart with gray dashed baseline |
| **Competitive comparison** | "Us X vs Competitor Y" | Side-by-side bar chart, highlight own data |
| **Target gap** | "Actual X / Target Y" | Progress bar + gap annotation |
| **Ranking** | "Ranked #N of M" | Horizontal bar chart + highlight marker |

**Data annotation three essentials**: Every data visualization must include (1) The value itself (large bold font) (2) Comparison reference (baseline / prior period / competitor) (3) Meaning interpretation ("So what?")

```xml
<text x="160" y="280" text-anchor="middle" font-size="42" font-weight="bold" fill="#1E293B">97.3%</text>
<text x="160" y="310" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#64748B">Industry avg 82% | Competitor A 89%</text>
<text x="160" y="335" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#059669">Leading industry by 15.3 percentage points</text>
```

---

## Pyramid Principle (Conclusion First)

> Executives don't care about your *process* — they care about *results*.

```
         ┌─────────────────┐
         │  Core Conclusion │   ← Page title / Takeaway
         └────────┬────────┘
      ┌───────────┼───────────┐
  ┌───┴───┐  ┌───┴───┐  ┌───┴───┐
  │ Arg 1 │  │ Arg 2 │  │ Arg 3 │   ← Key supporting points
  └───────┘  └───────┘  └───────┘
```

| Level | Position | Font Size |
|-------|----------|-----------|
| Core conclusion | Takeaway Box | 16-18px bold |
| Arguments | Content area body | 14-16px |
| Supporting data | Charts / cards | 12-14px |

**Contrast**: Title "Market Research Results" (wrong) → "Metaverse needs 5-10 years to reach scale" (right); Body "We researched... and found..." (wrong) → "Three arguments: (1)... (2)... (3)..." (right)

---

## MBB-level Layout Patterns

### Content Page Standard Structure (1280x720)

```
┌──────────────────────────────────┐
│ Gradient top bar (0,0 → 1280,6)  │
├──────────────────────────────────┤
│ Assertion title (x=40, y=50, 24px)│
├──────────────────────────────────┤
│ Takeaway Box (x=40, y=75,        │  ← Dark background + white text, one-sentence conclusion
│   w=1200, h=45)                  │
├──────────────────────────────────┤
│ Content area (x=40, y=140,       │  ← Charts / data / analysis
│   w=1200, h=520)                 │
├──────────────────────────────────┤
│ Source | CONFIDENTIAL | Page #    │  ← y=700, 10px
└──────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Strategic Roadmap

Three phases laid out horizontally, `<rect rx="8">` + title + action list, `<polygon>` arrows connecting:

```
Focus Core (0-6mo)  ──>  Expand Capability (6-12mo)  ──>  Scale Up (12-18mo)
x=40,w=380              x=450,w=380                     x=860,w=380
```

### Benchmarking Matrix

Horizontal table; own row highlighted in theme color, others in gray. Leading indicators marked green, lagging marked red. Use `<circle>` or `<rect>` to build score points.

### Waterfall Chart (Change Attribution)

Start → increase/decrease factors → End. Positive factors green bars, negative factors red bars, start/end points dark bars, cumulative line as dashed connector.

---

## Strategic Use of Color

MBB-level color usage is extremely restrained — color serves information:

| Purpose | Method |
|---------|--------|
| **Focus** | Target data in theme color, everything else gray |
| **Reduce cognitive load** | Same series differentiated by opacity (`fill-opacity` 1.0/0.6/0.3) |
| **Semantics** | Green = positive, Red = negative, Gray = baseline |
| **Branding** | Gradient top bar / decorative lines in brand color |

**Commandments**: No more than 3 primary colors; accent color used at most 2-3 places globally; data series use same-hue depth variations, not different colors; background white or very light gray.

---

## Chart vs Table Selection Matrix

| Scenario | Recommended Form | Reason |
|----------|-----------------|--------|
| Comparing 2-7 categories | **Bar chart** | Visual comparison is intuitive |
| Time trends | **Line chart** | Time series clarity |
| Precise values / large rankings | **Table** | 50 data points in a bar chart would be chaotic |
| Proportional composition | **Donut chart** | More modern than pie charts |
| Two-dimensional positioning | **2x2 matrix** | Strategic quadrant analysis |
| Change attribution | **Waterfall chart** | Factor decomposition |

---

## Speaker Notes Style

### Narrative Tone

Targeting **executives / decision-makers**. Pyramid structure — every sentence carries information. Composed, authoritative, and insightful tone.

### Stage Direction Markers

| Marker | Purpose | Example |
|--------|---------|---------|
| `[Pause]` | Silence after key insight, let executives absorb | "This means we are missing a billion-dollar market. [Pause]" |
| `[Scan Room]` | Observe decision-makers' reactions, decide whether to elaborate | "[Scan Room] If there are questions, I can elaborate." |
| `[Data]` | Conversational number delivery | "[Data] 63% → nearly two-thirds" |
| `[Benchmark]` | Emphasize comparison baseline | "[Benchmark] Compared to the industry average of 12%, our 23% is nearly double" |
| `[Transition]` | Bridge from previous page, at start of each page's text | "[Transition] Building on the strategic framework, let's drill into the implementation path." |

### Notes Writing Guidelines

- **Pyramid structure**: Conclusion → Arguments → Details
- **Data contextualization**: Every number has a comparison reference
- **Executive language**: "The strategic implication is...", "The core insight is..."
- **Flex mechanism**: Annotate "content that can be skipped if time is tight" for flexible duration
- **Key points structure**: `Key points: (1) Core insight (2) Data support (3) Strategic implication`

### Notes Example

```markdown
# 03_strategic_path

[Transition] Having clarified the problem and the opportunity, now comes the most critical part — our response path.

We recommend a three-phase strategy. [Pause]

Phase one: Focus. Over the next six months, concentrate resources on conquering the Eastern China market.
[Data] Eastern China contributes nearly two-thirds of industry growth, [Benchmark] yet our penetration rate is only half of Competitor A's. [Pause]

Phase two: Expand. Use Eastern China as a template, replicate to Southern and Northern China.
Phase three: Scale. Leverage a digital platform for nationwide coverage.

[Scan Room] The resource allocation for phase one is in the appendix — would you like me to walk through it now?

Key points: (1) Focus-Expand-Scale three-phase approach (2) Data-backed Eastern China priority (3) 18-month full deployment
Duration: 3 minutes
Flex: [If time is tight, skip phase two and three details and go straight to financial impact]
```

---

## MBB-level Quality Checklist Supplement

### Content Level

- [ ] **SCQA complete**: Overall follows Situation-Complication-Question-Answer structure
- [ ] **Data contextualized**: Every data point has a comparison reference
- [ ] **Conclusion first**: Every page's Takeaway Box has a one-sentence conclusion
- [ ] **MECE principle**: Categorized analysis is mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive

### Visual Level

- [ ] **Color with intent**: Colors serve information delivery
- [ ] **Ample whitespace**: Not crowded; information can "breathe"
- [ ] **Visual hierarchy**: Conclusion > Arguments > Details, differentiated by font size/weight
- [ ] **Brand consistency**: Gradient top bar and footer unified throughout

### Notes Level

- [ ] **Pyramid structure**: Every page is conclusion-first
- [ ] **Stage markers complete**: [Pause] and [Scan Room] at key positions
- [ ] **Flex content annotated**: Supports flexible duration

MBB-level color usage is extremely restrained — color serves information:

| Purpose | Method |
|---------|--------|
| **Focus** | Target data in theme color, everything else gray |
| **Reduce cognitive load** | Same series differentiated by opacity (`fill-opacity` 1.0/0.6/0.3) |
| **Semantics** | Green = positive, Red = negative, Gray = baseline |
| **Branding** | Gradient top bar / decorative lines in brand color |

**Commandments**: No more than 3 primary colors; accent color used at most 2-3 places globally; data series use same-hue depth variations, not different colors; background white or very light gray.

---

## Chart vs Table Selection Matrix

| Scenario | Recommended Form | Reason |
|----------|-----------------|--------|
| Comparing 2-7 categories | **Bar chart** | Visual comparison is intuitive |
| Time trends | **Line chart** | Time series clarity |
| Precise values / large rankings | **Table** | 50 data points in a bar chart would be chaotic |
| Proportional composition | **Donut chart** | More modern than pie charts |
| Two-dimensional positioning | **2x2 matrix** | Strategic quadrant analysis |
| Change attribution | **Waterfall chart** | Factor decomposition |

---

## Speaker Notes Style

Targeting **executives / decision-makers**. Pyramid structure — every sentence carries information. Composed, authoritative, and insightful tone.

### Stage Direction Markers

|--------|---------|---------|
| `[Pause]` | Silence after key insight, let executives absorb | "This means we are missing a billion-dollar market. [Pause]" |
| `[Scan Room]` | Observe decision-makers' reactions, decide whether to elaborate | "[Scan Room] If there are questions, I can elaborate." |

| `[Benchmark]` | Emphasize comparison baseline | "[Benchmark] Compared to the industry average of 12%, our 23% is nearly double" |

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
    <!-- 模板: 封面页 - Google 风格 -->

    <defs>
        <!-- 背景渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="bgGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#E8F0FE;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#FFFFFF;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#E8F5E9;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>

        <!-- 标题渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="titleGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#1A73E8;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#0D47A1;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
    </defs>

    <!-- 背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#bgGradient)" />

    <!-- 装饰圆形 - 增加视觉层次 -->
    <circle cx="150" cy="150" r="120" fill="#4285F4" fill-opacity="0.08" />
    <circle cx="1130" cy="570" r="150" fill="#34A853" fill-opacity="0.08" />
    <rect x="900" y="80" width="180" height="180" rx="20" fill="#FBBC04" fill-opacity="0.06" transform="rotate(15 990 170)" />

    <!-- 左侧四色竖条 -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="10" height="180" fill="#4285F4" />
    <rect x="0" y="180" width="10" height="180" fill="#EA4335" />
    <rect x="0" y="360" width="10" height="180" fill="#FBBC04" />
    <rect x="0" y="540" width="10" height="180" fill="#34A853" />

    <!-- 中央内容卡片 -->
    <rect x="280" y="180" width="720" height="360" rx="24" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E8EAED" stroke-width="1" />

    <!-- 主标题 -->
    <text x="640" y="280" font-family="system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif" font-size="52" font-weight="700" fill="url(#titleGradient)" text-anchor="middle">
        {{TITLE}}
    </text>

    <!-- 副标题 -->
    <text x="640" y="335" font-family="system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="500" fill="#5F6368" text-anchor="middle">
        {{SUBTITLE}}
    </text>

    <!-- 四色分隔线 -->
    <line x1="380" y1="380" x2="530" y2="380" stroke="#4285F4" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <line x1="550" y1="380" x2="620" y2="380" stroke="#EA4335" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <line x1="640" y1="380" x2="710" y2="380" stroke="#FBBC04" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <line x1="730" y1="380" x2="900" y2="380" stroke="#34A853" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" />

    <!-- 演讲者姓名 -->
    <text x="640" y="440" font-family="system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="700" fill="#1A237E" text-anchor="middle">
        {{SPEAKER_NAME}}
    </text>

    <!-- 演讲者职位 -->
    <text x="640" y="478" font-family="system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#5F6368" text-anchor="middle">
        {{SPEAKER_TITLE}}
    </text>

    <!-- 日期 -->
    <g transform="translate(640, 510)">
        <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="3" fill="#4285F4" />
        <text x="0" y="25" font-family="system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="500" fill="#5F6368" text-anchor="middle">
            {{DATE}}
        </text>
    </g>

    <!-- 底部四色圆点装饰 -->
    <circle cx="520" cy="630" r="12" fill="#4285F4" fill-opacity="0.9" />
    <circle cx="570" cy="630" r="10" fill="#EA4335" fill-opacity="0.9" />
    <circle cx="610" cy="630" r="14" fill="#FBBC04" fill-opacity="0.9" />
    <circle cx="660" cy="630" r="10" fill="#34A853" fill-opacity="0.9" />
    <circle cx="700" cy="630" r="12" fill="#4285F4" fill-opacity="0.9" />
    <circle cx="750" cy="630" r="10" fill="#EA4335" fill-opacity="0.9" />

</svg>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
    <!-- 模板: 内容页 - Google 风格 -->

    <defs>
        <!-- 顶部四色渐变条 -->
        <linearGradient id="topGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4285F4;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="33%" style="stop-color:#EA4335;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="66%" style="stop-color:#FBBC04;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#34A853;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
    </defs>

    <!-- 白色背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF" />

    <!-- 顶部四色渐变条 -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="6" fill="url(#topGradient)" />

    <!-- 页面标题 -->
    <text x="60" y="85" font-family="system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif" font-size="46" font-weight="700" fill="#1A237E">
        {{PAGE_TITLE}}
    </text>

    <!-- 蓝色标题下划线 -->
    <rect x="60" y="100" width="120" height="4" rx="2" fill="#4285F4" />

    <!-- 内容区域 - 灵活布局占位 -->
    <!-- 
        可使用的布局模式：
        - KPI 网格 (2×2 或 2×3)
        - 左文右图 / 左图右文
        - 三栏卡片
        - 四象限
        - 上下分区
        - Dashboard 风格
        - 列表 + 说明
    -->
    <rect x="60" y="130" width="1160" height="520" fill="none" stroke="#E8EAED" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="8,8" />
    <text x="640" y="380" text-anchor="middle" fill="#9AA0A6" font-size="18" font-family="system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif">
        {{CONTENT_AREA}}
    </text>
    <text x="640" y="420" text-anchor="middle" fill="#9AA0A6" font-size="14" font-family="system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif">
        (由 Executor 根据实际内容自由布局)
    </text>

    <!-- 常用设计元素参考 -->
    <!-- 
        KPI 卡片: <rect rx="16" stroke="#4285F4" stroke-width="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
        浅灰背景块: <rect rx="12" fill="#F8F9FA"/>
        品牌色圆点: <circle r="12" fill="#4285F4"/>
        分隔线: <line stroke="#E8EAED" stroke-width="1"/>
        数据数字: font-size="56" font-weight="700" fill="#4285F4"
        数据标签: font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#5F6368"
    -->

    <!-- 底部四色圆点装饰 -->
    <g transform="translate(640, 680)">
        <circle cx="-60" cy="0" r="6" fill="#4285F4" />
        <circle cx="-30" cy="0" r="6" fill="#EA4335" />
        <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="6" fill="#FBBC04" />
        <circle cx="30" cy="0" r="6" fill="#34A853" />
        <circle cx="60" cy="0" r="6" fill="#4285F4" />
    </g>

    <!-- 页码（可选） -->
    <text x="1220" y="695" text-anchor="end" font-family="system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#9AA0A6">
        {{PAGE_NUM}}
    </text>

</svg>

  <text x="80" y="81" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Early movers gain compounding advantages — enterprise gen AI adoption is accelerating and is no longer optional for leaders.</text>

  <text x="100" y="163" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">1</text>

  <text x="172" y="140" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#1A237E">Gen AI is production-ready across all major industries</text>
  <!-- Annotation -->
  <text x="172" y="163" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5F6368">1,001 organizations — from automotive to telecom — are running gen AI in production, not pilots.</text>
  <text x="172" y="182" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5F6368">10× growth in 18 months confirms this is a structural shift, not a trend.</text>

  <text x="172" y="379" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5F6368">500% ROI (Mercari), 30% workload reduction (LUXGEN), 10,000+ hours saved annually (Toyota) — all in production.</text>
  <text x="172" y="398" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5F6368">These are not projections — they are documented outcomes from organizations at scale.</text>

  <text x="172" y="487" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5F6368">Multimodal creative production (Virgin Voyages, PODS) and enterprise code assistants (Renault Ampere) are scaling fast.</text>
  <text x="172" y="506" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5F6368">Gen AI is moving from text into video, images, and code at speed.</text>

  <rect x="60" y="540" width="1160" height="98" rx="10" fill="#EEF2FF" stroke="#4285F4" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <use data-icon="rocket" x="134" y="572" width="26" height="26" fill="#4285F4"/>
  <text x="172" y="572" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#1A237E">Adoption is accelerating — early movers compound their advantage</text>
  <text x="172" y="595" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5F6368">400 new use cases added in a single October 2025 update; the 10× growth in 18 months shows no sign of plateauing.</text>
  <text x="172" y="614" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#4285F4">The strategic question is no longer whether to deploy — it is where to start and how fast to scale.</text>

</svg>

  <!-- Title underline -->
  <rect x="60" y="50" width="150" height="4" rx="2" fill="#4285F4"/>
  <rect x="218" y="50" width="70" height="4" rx="2" fill="#EA4335"/>

  <rect x="374" y="50" width="170" height="4" rx="2" fill="#34A853"/>

  <!-- MBB Takeaway box -->
  <rect x="60" y="58" width="1160" height="36" rx="5" fill="#1A237E"/>
  <text x="80" y="81" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Early movers gain compounding advantages — enterprise gen AI adoption is accelerating and is no longer optional for leaders.</text>

  <!-- ===== TAKEAWAY ITEMS ===== -->

  <!-- Takeaway 1 -->
  <rect x="60" y="108" width="1160" height="98" rx="10" fill="#F8F9FA" stroke="#E8EAED" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="60" y="108" width="6" height="98" rx="3" fill="#4285F4"/>
  <!-- Number circle -->
  <circle cx="100" cy="157" r="22" fill="#4285F4"/>
  <text x="100" y="163" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
  <!-- Icon -->
  <use data-icon="circle-checkmark" x="134" y="140" width="26" height="26" fill="#4285F4"/>
  <!-- Headline -->
  <text x="172" y="140" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#1A237E">Gen AI is production-ready across all major industries</text>
  <!-- Annotation -->
  <text x="172" y="163" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5F6368">1,001 organizations — from automotive to telecom — are running gen AI in production, not pilots.</text>
  <text x="172" y="182" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5F6368">10× growth in 18 months confirms this is a structural shift, not a trend.</text>

  <!-- Takeaway 2 -->
  <rect x="60" y="216" width="1160" height="98" rx="10" fill="#F8F9FA" stroke="#E8EAED" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="60" y="216" width="6" height="98" rx="3" fill="#34A853"/>
  <circle cx="100" cy="265" r="22" fill="#34A853"/>
  <text x="100" y="271" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
  <use data-icon="users" x="134" y="248" width="26" height="26" fill="#34A853"/>
  <text x="172" y="248" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#1A237E">Customer and Employee agents are the most common entry points</text>
  <text x="172" y="271" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5F6368">Start here: highest ROI visibility, lowest organizational friction, fastest time to value.</text>
  <text x="172" y="290" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5F6368">These two archetypes dominate the 1,001 use cases across all 11 verticals.</text>

  <!-- Takeaway 3 -->
  <rect x="60" y="324" width="1160" height="98" rx="10" fill="#F8F9FA" stroke="#E8EAED" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="60" y="324" width="6" height="98" rx="3" fill="#EA4335"/>
  <circle cx="100" cy="373" r="22" fill="#EA4335"/>

  <text x="172" y="356" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#1A237E">Measurable ROI is achievable within months</text>
  <text x="172" y="379" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5F6368">500% ROI (Mercari), 30% workload reduction (LUXGEN), 10,000+ hours saved annually (Toyota) — all in production.</text>
  <text x="172" y="398" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5F6368">These are not projections — they are documented outcomes from organizations at scale.</text>

  <!-- Takeaway 4 -->
  <rect x="60" y="432" width="1160" height="98" rx="10" fill="#F8F9FA" stroke="#E8EAED" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="60" y="432" width="6" height="98" rx="3" fill="#FBBC04"/>
  <circle cx="100" cy="481" r="22" fill="#FBBC04"/>
  <text x="100" y="487" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">4</text>
  <use data-icon="sparkles" x="134" y="464" width="26" height="26" fill="#F9A825"/>
  <text x="172" y="464" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#1A237E">Creative and Code agents are the fastest-growing frontier</text>
  <text x="172" y="487" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5F6368">Multimodal creative production (Virgin Voyages, PODS) and enterprise code assistants (Renault Ampere) are scaling fast.</text>
  <text x="172" y="506" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5F6368">Gen AI is moving from text into video, images, and code at speed.</text>

  <!-- Takeaway 5 -->
  <rect x="60" y="540" width="1160" height="98" rx="10" fill="#EEF2FF" stroke="#4285F4" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="60" y="540" width="6" height="98" rx="3" fill="#4285F4"/>
  <circle cx="100" cy="589" r="22" fill="#4285F4"/>
  <text x="100" y="595" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">5</text>
  <use data-icon="rocket" x="134" y="572" width="26" height="26" fill="#4285F4"/>
  <text x="172" y="572" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#1A237E">Adoption is accelerating — early movers compound their advantage</text>
  <text x="172" y="595" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#5F6368">400 new use cases added in a single October 2025 update; the 10× growth in 18 months shows no sign of plateauing.</text>
  <text x="172" y="614" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#4285F4">The strategic question is no longer whether to deploy — it is where to start and how fast to scale.</text>

  <circle cx="580" cy="660" r="6" fill="#4285F4"/>
  <circle cx="610" cy="660" r="6" fill="#EA4335"/>
  <circle cx="640" cy="660" r="6" fill="#FBBC04"/>
  <circle cx="670" cy="660" r="6" fill="#34A853"/>
  <circle cx="700" cy="660" r="6" fill="#4285F4"/>

  <!-- Source footer -->
  <text x="60" y="695" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#9AA0A6">Source: Google Cloud — "1,001 real-world gen AI use cases from the world's leading organizations" · Matt Renner & Matt A.V. Chaban · October 2025</text>
  <text x="1220" y="707" text-anchor="end" font-family="system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#9AA0A6">7</text>

arguments.content:
# 01_cover

[Transition] Welcome. Let's begin with the scale of what we're examining today.

This deck draws on Google Cloud's October 2025 report documenting 1,001 real-world generative AI use cases from organizations worldwide. [Pause]

The report was first published in April 2024 with 101 entries. Eighteen months later, it has grown tenfold. The data covers 11 major industries and 6 agent types — Customer, Employee, Creative, Code, Data, and Security. Our goal today is to equip you with a structured view of where gen AI is delivering measurable ROI, and where the highest-leverage entry points are for your organization.

[Scan Room] Before we dive in — the strategic question is not whether gen AI will reshape your industry. It already is. The question is whether you are positioned to lead or follow.

Key points: (1) 1,001 documented use cases as of October 2025 (2) 11 industries × 6 agent types provides the organizing framework (3) This is the most comprehensive public evidence base on enterprise gen AI deployment
Duration: 1 minute

---

# 02_growth

[Transition] Let's start with the trajectory — because the pace of adoption tells us something important about urgency.

In April 2024, Google Cloud published 101 real-world gen AI use cases at Cloud Next. By October 2025 — 18 months later — that number had grown to 1,001. [Data] That is a 10× increase. [Pause]

What makes this significant is that 400 of those 1,001 entries were added in a single update. The authors themselves note this still "only scratches the surface." [Benchmark] For context: most technology paradigm shifts take decades to reach this kind of adoption breadth. Gen AI is moving at a pace we have not seen before.

[Scan Room] The strategic implication: organizations that move now are building advantages that compound over time. Early movers are not just ahead — they are learning faster.

Key points: (1) 10× growth in 18 months — from 101 to 1,001 (2) 400 new entries in the Oct 2025 update alone (3) Still in early exponential phase — no sign of plateau
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 03_taxonomy

[Transition] To make sense of 1,001 use cases, we need a framework. Here it is.

Google Cloud organizes the entire dataset by two dimensions: 11 industry verticals and 6 agent types. [Pause] This matrix is more than a classification tool — it is a strategic map.

The 6 agent types — Customer, Employee, Creative, Code, Data, and Security — represent the six primary modes through which enterprises are deploying generative AI today. Every cell in this matrix represents active deployments. No major industry is untouched.

[Data] The key insight: Customer and Employee agents dominate in density across all 11 rows. Creative agents are emerging fastest. Security agents appear across every regulated industry.

[Scan Room] As you look at this framework, I'd encourage you to ask: which cells represent your highest-priority opportunities?

Key points: (1) 11 industries × 6 agent types = the organizing taxonomy (2) All 66 intersections show active deployment (3) Framework enables structured prioritization for your own roadmap
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 04_automotive

[Transition] Let's go deep on one vertical — Automotive and Logistics — because it shows the full breadth of what's possible within a single industry.

From the cockpit to the curbside, every major agent type is deployed. [Pause]

On the Customer side: Mercedes-Benz has Gemini-powered natural conversation in the car; LUXGEN reduced its customer service workload by 30%; Volkswagen enables drivers to query owner's manuals via multimodal AI; PODS and Tombras generated over 6,000 unique billboard headlines across 299 NYC neighborhoods in just 29 hours.

[Data] On the Employee side: Toyota's factory AI platform saved over 10,000 man-hours per year. Rivian and Geotab use Gemini in Google Workspace for research, legal review, and onboarding at fleet scale.

[Benchmark] And on the Code side: Renault's Ampere division uses enterprise Gemini Code Assist that understands their own codebase and conventions — directly accelerating EV software development.

This single vertical demonstrates that gen AI is not a single point solution. It is a platform capability deployed across the entire value chain.

Key points: (1) Automotive deploys all major agent types in production (2) Quantified outcomes: 30% CS workload reduction (LUXGEN), 10,000+ hours/yr (Toyota), 6,000+ ad headlines in 29 hrs (PODS) (3) Full vertical coverage from factory floor to customer experience
Duration: 3 minutes

---

# 05_roi

[Transition] The question executives always ask is: what is the return? Let me give you the numbers.

These are not projections. These are production outcomes. [Pause]

First: Mercari, Japan's largest online marketplace, anticipates 500% ROI on its AI-powered customer service investment — while also reducing employee workload by 20%. [Data] 500% ROI. [Pause]

Second: LUXGEN reduced customer service workload by 30% using a Vertex AI chatbot. Third: Toyota saved over 10,000 man-hours per year through its factory AI platform. Fourth: PODS and Tombras generated 6,000+ unique ad headlines across all 299 New York City neighborhoods in just 29 hours.

[Benchmark] Additionally — Virgin Voyages is creating thousands of hyper-personalized video ads and emails in a single batch using Veo; Figma enables brand-approved image generation in seconds.

[Scan Room] The pattern here is clear: organizations that have deployed are seeing returns within months, not years.

Key points: (1) 500% ROI (Mercari), 30% workload reduction (LUXGEN), 10,000+ hours/yr (Toyota), 6,000+ headlines/29 hrs (PODS) (2) These are production results, not pilots or projections (3) ROI timeline is months — not years
Duration: 3 minutes
Flex: [If time is tight, focus on Mercari and Toyota as the two most compelling data points]

---

# 06_patterns

[Transition] Across all 1,001 use cases, three dominant patterns emerge. Understanding these patterns tells you where to start.

Pattern one: Conversational Customer Agents. This is the most visible entry point. Mercedes-Benz, GM, VW, LUXGEN, and Commerzbank are all deploying AI-powered virtual assistants to handle customer queries, reduce wait times, and lower human agent workloads. [Data] LUXGEN achieved 30% workload reduction. This pattern spans every industry from automotive to financial services.

Pattern two: Employee Productivity Agents. This is the broadest category — spanning all 11 industries. Companies like Uber, Rivian, and Geotab use Gemini for Google Workspace to summarize documents, accelerate research, draft content, review legal documents, and filter data. Toyota saved 10,000+ hours annually. [Pause]

Pattern three: Creative and Scale Agents. This is the fastest-growing frontier. Virgin Voyages creates thousands of hyper-personalized videos in a single batch. PODS generates 6,000+ real-time adaptive ad headlines in 29 hours. Figma produces brand-approved assets in seconds. Gen AI is moving from text into multimodal creative production at enterprise scale.

[Scan Room] The strategic implication: patterns one and two are your fastest paths to ROI. Pattern three is where competitive differentiation will be won in the next 18 months.

Key points: (1) Three dominant archetypes: Customer Agents, Employee Productivity, Creative Scale (2) Patterns one and two offer lowest friction and fastest ROI (3) Creative agents represent the emerging competitive frontier
Duration: 3 minutes

---

# 07_takeaways

[Transition] Let me close with the five things I want every leader in this room to take away.

One: Gen AI is production-ready, today, across every major industry. This is not a future technology. 1,001 organizations are running it in production right now. [Pause]

Two: Customer and Employee agents are your starting point. Highest ROI visibility, lowest organizational friction, fastest time to value. If you haven't started there, start there.

Three: Measurable ROI is achievable within months. [Data] 500% ROI, 30% workload reduction, 10,000 hours saved, 6,000 ad headlines in 29 hours. These are documented outcomes — not projections.

Four: Creative and Code agents are the next wave. Multimodal generation and enterprise code assistants are scaling fast. Organizations building capability here today will have structural advantages in 18 months.

Five — and this is the most important: Adoption is accelerating. [Data] 400 new use cases in a single update. The compounding advantage belongs to early movers. [Pause]

[Scan Room] The strategic question is no longer whether to deploy generative AI. It is where to start and how fast to scale. I'm here to help you answer that for your organization.

Key points: (1) Production-ready across all industries — this is a structural shift (2) Start with Customer/Employee agents for fastest ROI (3) Creative/Code agents are the emerging competitive frontier (4) Early movers compound — urgency is real
Duration: 3 minutes
Flex: [If time is tight, deliver takeaways 1, 3, and 5 — the bookend argument for urgency]
